name: LaserPecker LP2 Plus 10W
tagline: LaserPecker LP2 Plus: the 10W, 4,000 mm/s successor to the LP2
tldr: LaserPecker LP2 Plus is the 10W successor to the LP2: same portable multi-angle format, about six times faster (up to 4,000 mm/s) and able to cut thin basswood. The standard area is 100 × 100 mm; the slide extension brings it to 160 × 300 mm and the roller handles long items.
mainObjective: Desktop LaserPecker 10W for small shop personalization

priceRange.note: Official LaserPecker US store, Oct 2026: $859 to $1,499 depending on bundle

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: 10W on LaserPecker LP2 Plus: engraving-first: photo fills and leather at moderate speeds
Open-frame: plan laser glasses, exhaust, and workspace rules from day one
Software on the profile: trial your workflow on scrap before production
cons: Clear cast acrylic and thick production cutting still favor CO₂, not diode power alone

editorialDepth.advantages: LaserPecker LP2 Plus 10W suits makers who sell marks, photos, and gifts more than daily panel cutting. Reasonable open-frame entry price.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if you already quote 4 mm+ cutting in production. Not for cast acrylic or bare metal without spray.
